recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍綠色且呈細顆粒狀，核不規則分葉狀；周圍大量深染圓核的正染性紅血球母細胞代表紅系增生，符合溶血性貧血骨髓中的反應性組織球。
features: Single large histiocyte (arrow) with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm
Irregular, folded to lobulated nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
No clearly engulfed intact red cells or nucleated cells in its cytoplasm
Background erythroid hyperplasia with many small dense-nucleated late normoblasts
Maturing granulocytes (bands, segmented forms) and occasional larger precursors present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with prominent erythroid hyperplasia, dominated by late normoblasts with small, round, dense nuclei, along with maturing granulocytic elements. A large histiocyte (arrow) is present with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm and an irregular, folded nucleus. No definite hemophagocytosis is identified in this cell. Findings are consistent with a reactive, sea-blue-type histiocyte in the setting of increased erythroid turnover such as hemolytic anemia.

ddx.dx: Secondary storage (pseudo-Gaucher or sea-blue) histiocytes in CML or thalassemia
ddx.vs: These are morphologically similar and are separated by the clinical and hematologic context, such as basophilia with BCR::ABL1 in CML.
Gaucher cells show striated 'onion-skin' or crumpled cytoplasm and occur in large numbers with glucocerebrosidase deficiency.
HLH requires histiocytes with engulfed erythrocytes, platelets, or leukocytes plus clinical criteria, which are not evident here.
Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus with pink granular cytoplasm and osteoclasts have multiple separate nuclei, whereas this cell has a single nucleus with blue-green cytoplasm.
